listingCid.description: CID of the listing at time of purchase — immutable price anchor.

paymentRef.description: Stripe PaymentIntent ID or equivalent. Independently verifiable via payment processor.

licenseGrantCid.description: CID of the license.terms record at time of purchase. Resolved from the listing's licenseGrantCid.

buyerDid.description: DID of the buyer. Explicit field — previously only implied by appSig payload. Makes receipt queryable by buyer identity and consistent with purchase.consent record.

shippingAddress.description: For physical items. Lives in buyer's own PDS — they control this data.

appDid.description: DID of the Bazaar app that issued this receipt. Verifiers resolve this to get the public key for appSig verification.

issuerScope.description: DID of the artist/storefront this receipt was issued under.

appSig.description: Base64url signature by the Bazaar app service keypair (appDid) over SHA-256(purchasedAt:paymentRef:item.uri:listingCid:buyerDid). All five values are colon-delimited in the order listed. item.uri is the AT-URI from the item field. Verifiers reconstruct this payload from the receipt's plaintext fields and verify against the public key resolved from appDid — using kid to select the correct historical key if the keypair has been rotated. Immutable.

kid.description: Key identifier for the app service keypair that produced appSig. Format: merchant-key-{YYYY-MM-DD} where the date is the keypair's activation date, e.g. merchant-key-2026-08-29. Allows verifiers to select the correct historical key from the appDid DID document verificationMethod array without trying all keys exhaustively. kid is a hint — verifiers still verify cryptographically and should fall back to trying all non-revoked keys if the hinted key fails. Immutable.
